The latest announcement is out from Torm ( (TRMD) ).

On October 5, 2026, TORM plc announced that OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l., a selling shareholder indirectly owned by funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, has commenced a secondary public offering of 6,329,874 Class A common shares. The shares are being offered in the U.S. market with J.P. Morgan Securities LLC acting as sole underwriter, and the transaction is subject to market and other conditions.

The selling shareholder holds about 6% of TORM’s Class A common shares before the offering, and TORM itself is not issuing new shares and will receive no proceeds from the sale. The move represents a partial exit by a major financial backer without diluting existing shareholders, potentially increasing the free float and liquidity of TORM’s stock while leaving the company’s operational and capital structure unchanged.

A shelf registration statement covering the Class A common stock is already effective with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, enabling the offering to proceed once conditions allow. By facilitating this secondary sale through a single underwriter at a fixed public price, the transaction may broaden TORM’s U.S. investor base and further consolidate its presence on Nasdaq, with implications mainly for ownership structure rather than day-to-day operations.

The most recent analyst rating on (TRMD) stock is a Buy

with a DKK38.00 price target.

To see the full list of analyst forecasts on Torm stock,

see the TRMD Stock Forecast page .

TORM plc is one of the world’s leading carriers of refined oil products, operating a global fleet of product tanker vessels with a strong focus on safety, environmental responsibility and customer service. Founded in 1889, the company conducts business worldwide and its shares are listed on Nasdaq in Copenhagen and on Nasdaq in New York under the tickers TRMD and TRMD A.

From its base in London, TORM serves the international energy and shipping markets, transporting refined oil products across major trade routes. Its long operating history and dual listings provide access to a broad investor base, underpinning the company’s position in the product tanker segment of the maritime transport industry.
